findings.title: Identity committed before validation
findings.message: The deferred close and identity tracking leave a hole: when View is first called with an invalid (empty) ID, p.identity becomes "" and equals p.ID, so nothing is recorded. If the ID is then set while p.open is true, nothing closes unless p.open is set. This is mostly benign, but identity is updated before validation, so a rejected View with a new ID still commits the new identity. Repairing back to the original ID is then seen as another identity change, and that is intended. However, p.close() is called without any error path ordering guarantees relative to the later session capture.
findings.suggestion: Verify that identity is only advanced after validation succeeds, or document the intended behavior with a test for an empty-to-valid ID transition while open.
